title: ranges.json
description: The version-range model: for each span of PostgreSQL versions, which patch series apply, extra configure options and the features deliberately omitted. This is the only place version differences live; scripts contain no version-conditional logic. Builder images per range live in toolchain.lock.json.

to.description: Inclusive; use a high patch number (9.6.99, 17.99) to cover every minor.

patches.description: Series file name per target, inside patches/<target>/.

configure.description: Extra configure options for this range, as data.

omittedFeatures.description: Capabilities deliberately left out of this range's ports; the support matrix states them per version.
